label: X-Bartack
description: The X-bartack places an X-shaped cross of reinforcement stitching at each pocket corner, with the four legs of the cross radiating outward to anchor the pocket opening across multiple stress vectors simultaneously. This form is visually the most expressive of the conventional bartack options and has a long heritage in both tailoring and workwear where it appears on pocket corners and seam intersections that require maximum durability. On a bespoke suit it reads as a considered, artisanal flourish — a small mark of craft that rewards close inspection.
